items.exampleEn: My grandfather grew fond of the little cat.

items.sentenceEn: Don't lose your temper over small things.

items.audioZh: 我跟鄰居的狗玩時，我的貓會吃醋，躲到床底下。
options: It climbs onto the kitchen table

items.sentenceEn: The game was so tense that nobody spoke.
items.sentenceZh: 比賽緊張到沒有人說話。

items.sentenceEn: There was sorrow in her eyes.

items.stemEn: Everyone laughed, and even the serious teacher gave a little ____.
items.stemZh: 大家都笑了，連嚴肅的老師也輕聲笑了一下。

items.stemEn: She was ____ of her sister because everyone praised her sister's singing.
items.stemZh: 她嫉妒自己的姊妹，因為大家都稱讚她姊妹的歌聲。

items.passageEn: My grandmother is very fond of her garden. Her devotion to her flowers is amazing: she takes care of them every morning, even on weekends. Last spring, she entered a flower contest. On the day of the results, everyone in our family was tense. My little brother was a bit jealous, because Grandma spent more time with her flowers than with him. In the end, Grandma won second prize. She gave a happy chuckle and said, "Next year, first prize!" My brother said it was insane to work so hard for a prize, but he helped her anyway. Grandma has a gentle temper and never gets angry. She told us that after her best friend moved to another country, her garden helped her through a time of great sorrow.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶非常喜愛她的花園。她對花朵的熱愛令人讚嘆：她每天早上都會照顧它們，連週末也不例外。去年春天，她參加了一場花卉比賽。公布結果那天，我們全家都很緊張。我弟弟有點吃醋，因為奶奶花在花上的時間比陪他的時間還多。最後，奶奶得了第二名。她開心地輕笑一聲，說：「明年要拿第一名！」弟弟說為了一個獎這麼努力真是瘋了，但他還是幫了她。奶奶脾氣很溫和，從不生氣。她告訴我們，她最好的朋友搬到國外後，是這座花園陪她走過那段非常悲痛的日子。

questions.questionZh: 公布結果那天，家人的心情如何？

options: 奶奶把最大的獎品留給了鄰居的小孩
